note: SPAX11 (TUBA4A) presents with spastic ataxia and oculomotor signs (nystagmus, broken pursuit), differentiating it from pure HSP but overlapping clinically with other spastic ataxias and tubulinopathies.

evidence.text: TUBA4A p.Glu415Lys variant causes spastic ataxia characterized by lower limb spasticity, ataxia, and ocular movement signs such as nystagmus and broken smooth pursuit.

source.title: A new genetic cause of spastic ataxia: the p.Glu415Lys variant in TUBA4A
source.quote: ocular movements (nystagmus, broken smooth pursuit), and sometimes dysarthria

evidence.text: Screening confirmed TUBA4A as a hereditary spastic ataxia disease gene presenting with spasticity and/or cerebellar ataxia and ophthalmological abnormalities including nystagmus.

source.title: De novo and inherited monoallelic variants in TUBA4A cause ataxia and spasticity
